content_sections.heading: ICSIL Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ICSIL Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ICSIL Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ICSIL Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Fireman: 12th pass from a recognized board with working knowledge of fire safety and one year of experience as a fireman in a reputed organization. Lab Attendant: Matric or equivalent with Science or a degree in science with one year of experience in a Laboratory of a recognized hospital/institute. Sweeper: Ability to read and write in Hindi or the regional language with previous experience.

content_sections.heading: ICSIL Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 30 years for all posts. Age relaxation can be relaxed up to 35 years for those having a minimum experience of one year with central government or its organizations.

content_sections.heading: ICSIL Recruitment 2026 - Salary
content_sections.text: Fireman: Rs. 22,411/- Per Month Lab Attendant: Rs. 18,456/- Per Month Sweeper: Rs. 18,456/- Per Month

content_sections.text: Walk-in Interview/Interaction Document Verification Skill Test or Written Test (if applicable)

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICSIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for ICSIL Recruitment 2026 is scheduled to be held on 14th August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts announced by ICSIL?
faq.answer: ICSIL has announced vacancies for the posts of Fireman, Lab Attendant, and Sweeper.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for ICSIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 5 vacancies are available for the announced posts in ICSIL Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Fireman post?
faq.answer: For the Fireman post, candidates must have passed the 12th grade from a recognized board and possess working knowledge of fire safety, along with one year of experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the ICSIL recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable up to 35 years for candidates with at least one year of experience with central government organizations.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Lab Attendant and Sweeper posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered for both Lab Attendant and Sweeper posts is Rs. 18,456/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee for ICSIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 590/- for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ICSIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview/Interaction, Document Verification, and potentially a Skill Test or Written Test.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue for ICSIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 201301. The exact address will be detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificates (if applicable).
